Provenance.drafts: Every townsfolk body is a COMPOSITE, matching the six-hero-cast wave's own convention (art/build/town2d-hero-*.build.json): a stage-1 t2i base (SDXL base 1.0 + pixel-art-xl LoRA @1.0/1.0, 30 steps, cfg 7.0, dpmpp_2m/karras, 832x1216, batch of 4) picks one candidate; non-robed bodies (broad, belder, slight, steen) then get a SEPARATE walk-contact inpaint per side (SetLatentNoiseMask, denoise 0.5, same sampler/scheduler) for the two weight-bearing gait frames, with the two passing frames a same-render pixel sway of the adopted base -- no extra diffusion sample. ROBED bodies (bmatron, selder) have no visible legs and use the hand pipeline's own no-diffusion hem-sway idiom for ALL FOUR frames: no separate walk-contact render was ever generated for them (the art job's own folk_geom.json entries for bmatron/selder carry no walk seed at all, unlike the other four bodies). All rejected candidates are kept MISS-prefixed under the job's own tmp/folk/_work/ folder (gen_folk_bases.py, gen_folk_bases2.py, gen_folk_walks.py, assemble_folk.py, folk_geom.json).
Provenance.paintoverNote: Purely mechanical, and a KNOWN GAP (disclosed in tmp/folk/MANIFEST.txt's own KNOWN MISSES: "robed bodies: 2 distinct sway frames vs the hand pipeline's 4"): tmp/folk/_work/assemble_folk.py's robed branch of build_variant() only calls its PIL sway helper for F1/F3 (hem sway +-1px); F2 and F4 both reuse the literal adopted base render (seed 834100, 2nd candidate, 'a slender old villager woman in a muted sage green wool dress, ankle length skirt') UNSHIFTED. Measured directly (this file's own torso proof.txt): F2 and F4 are byte-identical to each other for every one of this silhouette's 5 palette variants. The walk cycle's two CONTACT poses (base/_step) still alternate correctly; only the two PASSING poses do not. Reported, not silently patched -- see TownSpriteArtTests.EveryVariantBody_ObeysTheSameGaitInvariantsAsItsBase's own documented carve-out for this exact id range.
Provenance.aiDisclosure: AI-generated (SDXL base 1.0 + pixel-art-xl) diffuse for every opaque pixel, but this specific frame adds no new generation AND, unlike every other body in this cast, no pixel shift either: it is the adopted base render's own bytes, unmodified -- byte-identical to its _walk2 sibling. A known, disclosed gap (see tmp/folk/MANIFEST.txt's KNOWN MISSES), not a fresh defect introduced here.
